name: Yuuki Akiko
source: The kind, beautiful, and mature leader of the group, she is also the oldest. She is calm and determined, and relied upon by the others. On the other hand, she has slight feminine streak in regards to insect and being bad with machines. Her dream is to get married one day, and to become a bride.
